confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Cusco and Peru, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with July high-season demand. Draught beer is less common than bottled beer, so the beer anchor is a bottled-beer proxy. FX is the 15 Oct 2026 RBA figure as reported in a search summary; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Andean and Peruvian tourist-city price levels (Arequipa and tourist districts of Lima as rough reference points), adjusted for Cusco's high-season tourist demand. No live pages were inspected and no web search was used for these anchors.
